title: Glasbakken in Amsterdam 1981
authors: Bakker, J.H.M., Universiteit van Amsterdam * Amsterdam, Interfacultaire vakgroep milieukunde (primary investigator)
contributors: Interfacutaire vakgroep milieukunde, UvA * Amsterdam (data collector)
descriptions: Study of first experiences with separated collecting of glass-refuse in Amsterdam since introduction, may 1981. To get information / who brings glass-refuse to container / way of transport, frequency / distance from residence / motivation / complaints / possible improvements / collecting separated refuse / willingness to cooperate / cleanliness of neighbourhood. Background variables: basic characteristics/ household characteristics
